create_banner.name: Create banner
create_banner.description: Shows a banner in every Heads Up card. Calling it again with the same ID replaces the banner.

id.name: ID
id.description: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _; up to 64 characters. Generated and returned when empty.

title.name: Title
title.description: Up to 100 characters. Default: no title.

severity.name: Severity
severity.description: Sets color, default icon and sort order. Default: Warning.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Replaces the default icon of the severity. Default: the icon of the severity.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: The banner disappears after this time, also across restarts. 0 = no timeout. Default: the timeout from the integration options (24 hours unless changed).

dismissible.name: Dismissible
dismissible.description: Shows a close button on the banner. Default: on.

dismiss_scope.name: Dismiss scope
dismiss_scope.description: Per user: closing hides it only for that user. Everyone: closing removes it for all. Default: the setting from the integration options (per user unless changed).

snoozable.name: Snoozable
snoozable.description: Lets viewers hide the banner for a while; it returns afterwards. Ignored (error) together with dismissible off. Default: the setting from the integration options (off unless changed).

snooze_scope.name: Snooze scope
snooze_scope.description: Per user: snoozing hides it only for that user. Everyone: it hides for all. Default: the setting from the integration options (per user unless changed).

snooze_options.name: Snooze choices
snooze_options.description:
Up to 6 snooze durations, 1 minute to 7 days.

Example:
```yaml
- minutes: 15
- hours: 4
```

actions.name: Buttons
actions.description:
Up to 3 buttons with key, label, optional dismiss and action.

Example:
```yaml
- key: ack
  label: Got it
  dismiss: true
```

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Group name for card filters and for clearing several banners at once. Lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 64 characters, no spaces. Example: laundry. Default: no tag.

condition.name: Condition
condition.description:
Show the banner only while an entity matches or a template is true. Keys: entity_id, operator, state, attribute, template, for.

Example:
```yaml
entity_id: binary_sensor.window
state: "on"
for:
  minutes: 5
```

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Once: removed when the condition turns false. Recurring: hidden while false, shown again when true. Default: Once.

wait_for_condition.name: Wait for condition
wait_for_condition.description: On: a banner whose condition is false now waits until it turns true. Off: nothing is stored and the response status is condition_false. Default: on. Ignored without a condition.

people.name: People
people.description: Show only to these people. Default: everyone.

tap_action.name: Tap action
tap_action.description:
Home Assistant action run when the banner is tapped.

Example:
```yaml
action: navigate
navigation_path: /lovelace/0
```

user.title: Add watch rule
user.description: Shows a banner on every Heads Up card while an entity is in a state. {name_token} in the message is replaced by the entity's name. The message can also use Home Assistant templates.

data_description.name: Shown in the list of rules only.
data_description.entity_id: Entity to watch. Use this or a template, not both.
data_description.operator: How the entity (or its attribute) is compared with the values below.
data_description.state: Equals, does not equal, contains and does not contain take one or more values (default: on for equals and does not equal). Above and below take one number; between takes two, low then high, both included. Is empty and is not empty need no value.
data_description.attribute: Compare this attribute instead of the state.
data_description.template: Instead of an entity: a Home Assistant template that is true while the banner should show. Leave Condition, State and Attribute empty.
data_description.for: Optional. The banner appears only after the condition has held this long without a break, up to 24 hours. Empty: right away. After a restart the wait starts again.
data_description.title: Optional heading, up to 100 characters.
data_description.people: Show only to these people. Empty: everyone.
data_description.dismissible: Off: no close button, the banner stays while the condition is true. On: each user can hide it until the condition turns false and true again.
data_description.dismiss_scope: Per user: closing hides it for that user until the condition turns false and true again. Everyone: closing hides it for all until then. Empty: per user.
data_description.enabled: Turn off to hide the banner without deleting the rule.
data_description.snoozable: On: viewers can hide the banner for a while; it returns afterwards. Needs Dismissible. Empty: the setting from the integration options.
data_description.snooze_scope: Per user or everyone. Empty: the setting from the integration options.
data_description.snooze_options: Durations offered to the viewer. Empty: the setting from the integration options.
data_description.actions:
Up to 3 buttons with key, label, optional dismiss and action. Dismiss needs Dismissible.

Example:
```yaml
- key: ack
  label: Got it
  dismiss: true
```

Home Assistant action run when the banner is tapped.

Example:

```yaml
action: navigate
navigation_path: /lovelace/0
```

user.title: Add policy
user.description: Escalation: if nobody acknowledges within the time, deliver on more channels. Reminder: repeat the notification while nobody acknowledges. Empty severities or tags mean any. Rule messages have the tag "rule". Quiet hours: hold, quiet or drop deliveries in a time window. Away: send to people who are not home when they arrive. Fallback: use other channels when nobody could be notified. Summarize: hold messages on every channel, including the banner, and send one summary per recipient. Deliver: send matching messages to a chosen audience on chosen channels at once, in addition to what the call names.

data_description.name: Used by the policy field of a call. Must be unique and cannot be "none".
data_description.severities: Only messages of these severities. Empty: any.
data_description.tags: Only messages with one of these tags. Empty: any.
data_description.after_minutes: Escalation: minutes without acknowledgement before the channels below are used.
data_description.channels: Escalation: channels to add. Reminder: limit to these channels, empty for all.
data_description.dismiss_acks: Escalation: a dismissal stops the escalation, as an acknowledgement does.
data_description.max_count: Reminder: how many times to repeat.
data_description.push_audience: Escalation: give either an audience or recipients per channel, never both.
data_description.speak_recipients: Escalation: speech takes recipients, not an audience.
data_description.from_time: Quiet hours: start of the window, in the Home Assistant time zone.
data_description.to_time: Quiet hours: end of the window. A window may cross midnight.
data_description.days: Quiet hours: the days a window starts on. Empty: every day.
data_description.action: Quiet hours: send quietly (push without sound, no speech), hold until the end, or drop the delivery.
data_description.critical_passes: Quiet hours: critical messages ignore this policy.
data_description.max_wait: Away: minutes to wait for the person to arrive. 0: as long as the message lives.
data_description.when: Fallback: when to use the channels and targets above. Nobody to notify: the audience resolved to nobody. Delivery failed: the person has no usable device or sending failed.
data_description.summary_every: Summarize: send one summary this many minutes after the first message was held.
data_description.summary_at: Summarize: send one summary at this time every day instead of by the interval.
data_description.include_critical: Summarize: also hold critical messages. Off: critical messages are delivered at once.
